_source: TaoStats /api/subnet/identity/v1 discovery sample 2026-07-14 (2-call focused probe, limit=2, page 1+2). {pagination, data} envelope; per-item on-chain SubnetIdentity fields, all nullable except netuid. github_repo is str|null. The endpoint does NOT carry the subnet owner ss58 (that is on /api/subnet/latest/v1) — the fleet fingerprint therefore keys on the normalized repo URL. total_items 129 / total_pages 1 at limit=200 (whole map in one call). Extra fields (subnet_url, discord, description, logo_url, subnet_contact, additional, summary, tags, twitter) are tolerated by the validator.
